title: COMPOSITIONAL PREFERENCE MODELS FOR ALIGNING LMS

bias_targets.methodology: Using a prompted language model (e.g., GPT-3.5, Flan-T5) to extract a feature score on a scale of 1 to 10 evaluating whether a language model's response is 'biased or one-sided' versus 'objective and impartial'.

Prompting a language model to score responses from 1 to 10 based on whether the text fails to consider the original poster's cultural or individual preferences (evaluated as the 'fail-to-consider-individual-preferences' feature).
